# tests/fixtures/fide_greats/

Status: DRAFT — test fixtures, not for publication.

`published_periods.json` (session ELO-9, Phase 3): FIDE's published per-player calculations of a few of the greats' periods, one for each rule `src/layer0_greats/` transcribes from the texts in force before July 2017 (`docs/research/VERIFICATION_RATING-REGULATIONS-2001-2017.md`; `docs/specs/SPEC-GREATS_v1_0.md` §6): F-G01 the 350-point rule before July 2009, F-G02 and F-G03 the 400-point rule from July 2009 (a capped game, and a gap of 351 to 400 points counted in full), F-G04 K 15, F-G05 the 400-point rule of the 2014 regulations; and F-G06, every period on a list before July 2014 whose sum ends in exactly a half point, with the published change (the rounding the texts leave open; E20 §4.2). Written by `tools/data/assemble_greats_fixtures.py` from the pages cached by `tools/data/fetch_greats_calculations.py` and FIDE's lists. Opponents are identified by the rating FIDE used, never by name, and no player's FIDE ID or event is recorded; the values are single figures quoted from FIDE's calculations and lists for verification, as in `tests/fixtures/fide_history/`. `tests/test_layer0_greats.py` checks `src/layer0_greats/` against them.
